question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH filtered_words AS (
  SELECT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) = 'r'
),
sorted_chars AS (
  SELECT 
    words,
    LENGTH(words) as len,
    STRING_AGG(letter, '' ORDER BY letter) as sorted_chars
  FROM filtered_words,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(words, '')) AS letter
  GROUP BY words
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    sorted_chars,
    len,
    COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM sorted_chars
  GROUP BY sorted_chars, len
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
  sc.words,
  ag.anagram_count
FROM sorted_chars sc
JOIN anagram_groups ag ON sc.sorted_chars = ag.sorted_chars AND sc.len = ag.len
WHERE ag.anagram_count >= 2
ORDER BY sc.words
LIMIT 10
